## Design

### 2026-10-14 – I made each individual leg and the assembly and body! i started out just making a simple hexapod, then i had a revelation... what if i made ROCKY FROM PHM!??!?!?!?!?!?! I redid all of the legs, making

**9.1h**

I made each individual leg and the assembly and body! i started out just making a simple hexapod, then i had a revelation... what if i made ROCKY FROM PHM!??!?!?!?!?!?! I redid all of the legs, making them 3 toed and rocky-like, and put them in an assembly. I used joints to make everything movable, a combination of multiple files, and I made each leg unique and the front 2 special (their toes are different.) check it out!!!
it also has spots for servos so it'll be completely movable :D

OK SO
i figured out everything i'm buying, from aliexpress, after watching a video about how to control 10 servos. I used a real servo and realized that all my measurements from before were off, and i spent  3 hours updating the legs using new measurements... RAHHHHHHHHH

then i spent an hour finding the parts i need on aliexpress and then i realized that i had no way to thread the wires through the legs so i made holes, and I made the base of rocky hollow so that can be where all the electronics are stored. (kinda genius imo <3) but um yeah! Now i gotta update my repo!
